title: Knight shield
content:
# Knight shield

Internal ID: ShieldKnight | Type: Shield | Source: Console | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: n/a | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The knight shield is an unused asset with the appearance of a kite shield but the function of a round shield.

## Availability

Currently only obtainable via console commands. See banded shield for obtainable iron tier round shield.

## Notes

• It is currently not mounted properly in game. When equipped, it clips into the player's arm and when sheathed or blocking it is mounted/held sideways.

Categorias: Unfinished, Weapons, Shields
